sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 433)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio, Armed Forces transcription discs, and British radio comedy, Clyde Campbell and Don Knotts on *Bobby Benson and the B-Bar-B Riders* for Kraft (1951 Kraft Master & Syndicated Master), country legends Ernest Tubb and Red Foley harmonizing *Goodnight Irene* on AFRS (1950), Joan Gardner as *The Story Lady* telling *The Story of Dr. Dolittle* (1949), Burmese treasure thrills on *Stand By For Adventure* (1946), and advertising agency satire on *Something to Shout About* (1946–1960):
